verdict.rationale: Lovable documents two built-in security scanners (Basic scan and Deep scan) plus optional connectors for more coverage, and enterprise plans add scheduled Deep scans and workspace-wide security oversight. This is a first-party, platform-run security review of the generated app. Generated auth also applies row level security by default. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that scans run or gate before publishing, details of what the scanners check, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scan effectiveness.
